subject: SignalBoard renewal: pricing options, SSO/audit evidence, and PO path
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <claire@signalboard.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SignalBoard renewal proposal and FY27 pricing

Hi Aditya and Lauren,

Thanks again for the check-in last week. Attached is our proposal for Redwood Inference's FY27 renewal (SignalBoard_Renewal_Proposal_20270503.pdf). Highlights:

- 12-month and 24-month pricing tiers included; 24-month gives 8% additional discount.
- Up to 150 seats included in the standard plan; overage priced at $4/user/month.
- Enterprise SSO and audit log exports included in the Enterprise tier.
- Page/incident credits and optional on-call training workshop (half-day).

Quick asks from our side so we can finalize:
1) Confirm anticipated seat count for next 12 months (current 98 active).
2) Do you need SOC 2 Type II evidence and which scope (platform vs. app)?
3) PO process — do you prefer a PO before DocuSign or after?

I've attached the proposal and a clean SLA. Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Best,
Claire Jensen
Enterprise Accounts
SignalBoard
(claire@signalboard.io)

Attachments: SignalBoard_Renewal_Proposal_20270503.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Jensen <claire@signalboard.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SignalBoard renewal proposal and FY27 pricing

Thanks Claire — got the proposal and skimmed the SLA. A few quick clarifying items from our side before we share with procurement: 

- Seat forecast: we expect ~120 seats active by Q4 FY27, with potential spikes during hiring pushes. Can you confirm whether unused seats roll to the next month or are billed as consumed?
- Audit logs: we need daily SSO/auth logs retention for 13 months and the ability to export to our SIEM (S3 or Splunk). Can you confirm export formats and latency?
- Service credits / SLOs: SLA has 99.5% availability, but our SRE asks if you offer credits for degraded alerting (e.g., delayed webhook delivery).
- Migration: if we opt to downgrade to a lighter plan for some teams, is there a one-time migration fee for moving rotation schedules?

CCing Lauren and Marcus for procurement and SRE input. If you can answer the bullets inline that helps speed the PO.

Thanks,

--
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
From: Claire Jensen <claire@signalboard.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SignalBoard renewal proposal and FY27 pricing

Hi Aditya — thanks for the detailed notes. Answers below and I've attached an updated proposal with a call-out for exports.

- Seat billing: seats are billed on the peak concurrent active seat in the month. Unused seats do not roll forward, but we offer a 10% buffer on top of committed seats for the first quarter after renewal.
- Audit logs: we can deliver daily SSO/auth logs in JSON or CSV to your S3 bucket. Typical delivery latency is <30 minutes. We also provide a Splunk HEC integration for live streaming.
- Service credits: we provide credits for platform downtime and for webhook delivery windows beyond our SLA. I can share the credit table from the SLA (see attachment).
- Migration fees: rotation schedule migration is complimentary for teams <50 seats; for larger moves we quote time-and-materials. We're willing to include one migration wave as a concession for a 24-month commitment.

I've attached SignalBoard_Renewal_Proposal_20270503.pdf (updated) and a clean copy of the SLA. Let me know if you want to mark any redlines and Lauren can share procurement timelines.

Best,
Claire

Attachments: SignalBoard_Renewal_Proposal_20270503.pdf (PDF, 428KB)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SignalBoard renewal proposal and FY27 pricing

Team — draft negotiation plan and procurement asks. Reply-all when you agree and I'll open the PO ticket.

Summary: SignalBoard's updated proposal addresses most of our SRE concerns (S3 export + Splunk HEC). We need to firm up seat counts and lock in concessions. Proposed terms to request: 

- 24-month term at the quoted 8% additional discount (to hit budget cadence).
- Include a one-time migration wave at no charge (covering up to 120 seats).
- Cap overage at $3.50/user/month for first 12 months.
- Add explicit webhook delivery SLO with a 15-minute window and associated service credits tiers (request inclusion in SLA).
- Delivery of SOC 2 Type II report within 10 business days for procurement file.

Procurement steps: 
- I'll open the PO request JIRA (JIRA-SUP-4993) and request PO to be created after DocuSign. We prefer DocuSign -> PO -> payment. If SignalBoard requires PO first, we can accommodate but need a 2-week lead time.

Attachments: SLA_redlines_Aditya_20270506.docx (contains proposed redlines for webhook SLO and credits).

Notes: Marcus — can you confirm whether the migration wave coverage is sufficient for SRE? Grace — please confirm compliance needs for SOC 2 delivery.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Jensen <claire@signalboard.io>, SignalBoard Sales <sales@signalboard.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-partner.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Final terms request & PO path for SignalBoard renewal

Claire — thanks for the quick turn. We reviewed the updated proposal internally and are prepared to move forward pending confirmation of the items below. We'd like these captured in the final DocuSign package before routing to procurement: 

1) 24-month term at the 8% multi-year discount; overage cap at $3.50/user/month for first 12 months.
2) One complimentary migration wave covering up to 120 seats and the scheduling support for rotation imports.
3) Webhook delivery SLO inserted into SLA (15-minute delivery window) with the service credits table included exactly as proposed in Lauren's redlines.
4) SOC 2 Type II report delivery within 10 business days of signature; confirmation that platform logs delivered to our S3 path (we'll send the bucket ARN after signature).
5) DocuSign preferred flow: final DocuSign envelope -> Redwood signs -> we issue PO within 3 business days -> vendor invoices per net-30. If SignalBoard requires PO first, confirm and note expected delay.

If you can prepare a DocuSign envelope with these items captured, include a copy of the final SLA and the updated proposal. We'll route immediately to procurement (Lauren) and legal (Grace) for final sign-off.

Looking forward — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
